main_subject.description: An original adult woman with long dark-brown side-parted hair and a soft slightly cheerful expression.
main_subject.wardrobe: An oversized blue-and-white striped knit sweater, small plain silver hoops, and delicate unbranded silver rings.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: High-angle close selfie with both hands gently cupping the cheeks.

composition_elements.setting: Dim neutral room with a dark plain wall and no visible personal items.
composition_elements.framing: High-angle close portrait, hands and face in sharp focus, sweater texture visible.
composition_elements.text_and_brand_control: No named person, exact face preservation, logo, text, watermark, or branded model/tool wording.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Cool dim ambient light plus soft direct camera flash.

technical_specs.rendering: Natural skin, precise hands, knitted texture, faint grain, no plastic retouching.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical 35mm flash-selfie portrait of an original adult woman with long dark-brown side-parted hair and a soft slightly cheerful expression. She wears an oversized blue-and-white striped knit sweater, small plain silver hoops, and delicate unbranded silver rings. Frame a high-angle close selfie as both hands gently cup her cheeks. Use a dim neutral room with a dark plain wall, cool ambient light plus soft direct flash, natural skin, precise hands, visible knitted texture, faint grain, and no plastic retouching. No named person, exact face preservation, model/tool reference, logo, readable text, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, named person, identity lock, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, logo, readable text, watermark, distorted hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Any identity reference is optional and must depict a consenting adult. Wardrobe and makeup references are replaceable guides that cannot contain labels or text.
